# OpenAPI Generator CXF JAX-RS Client OSGi DS

> An OpenAPI Generator plugin that produces CXF JAX-RS client stubs packaged as OSGi Declarative Services bundles.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with Maven Wrapper
- Single-module project built on OpenAPI Generator 4.2.2
- Extends `JavaCXFClientCodegen` with custom Mustache templates for OSGi DS activator and Maven POM generation
- Generated activator creates CXF client proxies via `JAXRSClientFactory` and registers each API interface as an OSGi service
- Runtime stack: Apache CXF 3.3.0, Jackson 2.9.9, OSGi Core + Compendium 6.0.0
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Components

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/openapi/codegen/JavaCXFClientOsgiDsCodegen.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/openapi/codegen/JavaCXFClientOsgiDsCodegen.java): The sole generator class — extends JavaCXFClientCodegen to add OSGi DS support, registered via Java SPI
- [src/main/resources/JavaJaxRS/cxf/osgi/ds/modelServiceActivator.mustache](src/main/resources/JavaJaxRS/cxf/osgi/ds/modelServiceActivator.mustache): Mustache template that generates the OSGi DS activator (ClientApiServiceActivator.java)
- [src/main/resources/JavaJaxRS/cxf/osgi/ds/pom.mustache](src/main/resources/JavaJaxRS/cxf/osgi/ds/pom.mustache): Mustache template that generates the output project's POM with bundle packaging
- [src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.openapitools.codegen.CodegenConfig](src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.openapitools.codegen.CodegenConfig): Java SPI registration for OpenAPI Generator discovery

## Tests

- [src/test/java/hu/blackbelt/openapi/SampleRunner.java](src/test/java/hu/blackbelt/openapi/SampleRunner.java): Unit test that programmatically runs the generator against a sample OpenAPI spec
- [src/it/k8s/](src/it/k8s/): Maven Invoker integration test that verifies generated code compiles and passes tests

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Project build configuration with CI-friendly ${revision} versioning (1.0.2-SNAPSHOT)
